A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PMD convergence work and are readable through Appendices A-F. Text, equations, proofs, and diagrams support reliable comparison; v2's unresolved citations do not prevent it.

before.justification: v1 reports theoretical convergence results, proofs, and analytically constructed MDP examples, but no original experimental, simulation, or data-analysis results.

after.justification: v2 retains the same theoretical results and analytical examples. Neither the main text nor the appendices report original empirical results.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1's on-policy PMD update, oracle assumptions, Euclidean and negative-entropy regularizers, and epsilon-greedy exploration procedure are unchanged.

E1.justification: Neither version evaluates datasets or benchmark tasks. The theoretical MDP constructions in Figures 1-3 and Appendices A.2 and B.2 are unchanged.

E2.justification: Neither version reports empirical baseline comparisons. The analytical comparisons with earlier closure-based convergence guarantees in Section 1.2 and Appendix A.2 are retained.

E3.justification: No experimental evaluation protocol is introduced or revised. Parameters and conditions used in the analytical MDP examples remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The closure-versus-VGD example in Appendix A.2 and exploration-dependence analysis in Appendix B.2 are unchanged. No ablation, robustness test, or additional case analysis is introduced.

E5.justification: Neither version reports empirical run counts, seeds, uncertainty intervals, or significance tests. The statistical-error terms remain unchanged theoretical oracle-error assumptions.

E6.justification: No empirical scores are reported in either version. Numerical quantities and findings in the analytical examples are unchanged; relocated passages do not constitute new results.

T1.justification: The formal definitions, assumptions, Theorems 1-3, convergence rates, and supporting derivations and counterexamples are unchanged. Appendices A-F match after accounting for whitespace and figure placement.

C1.justification: Both versions retain the claims of best-in-class PMD convergence under VGD instead of closure and state-space-size-independent rates obtained through local smoothness. The abstract and principal contribution statements are unchanged.

C2.justification: After Theorem 1, v2 attributes the smooth-regularizer requirement specifically to its current analysis rather than suggesting a limitation of existing techniques. Section 4 replaces the nonsmooth-regularizer outlook with discussion of VGD's exploration and optimization implications and possible relaxations.

D1.justification: Pseudocode, oracle conditions, tuning prescriptions, and the dual and log-linear parameterization details in Appendix F are unchanged. No implementation resources or code/data access information are added.

R1.justification: Section 1.3 adds a paragraph attributing the dynamically weighted mirror-descent viewpoint to earlier work, including Tomar et al. (2020), and singles out an unidentified work as lacking convergence guarantees. The bibliography is unchanged, but several in-text citations appear as '?'.

P1.justification: Limited prose revisions add the related-work paragraph, shorten the qualification after Theorem 1, and replace one outlook bullet. The section hierarchy is retained; v2 also introduces unresolved citation markers.

P2.justification: Figures 2 and 3 move relative to their surrounding appendix text, with accompanying repagination of prose, equations, and acknowledgments. The three diagrams and their captions are unchanged; no figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: The discussion refinements provide some useful context, but v2 reduces attribution clarity: Section 1.3 replaces the readable Vaswani et al. (2021) citation with '?' and introduces two further unresolved citation markers. These defects leave a newly emphasized prior work unidentified and outweigh the modest explanatory gains, while the mathematical contribution remains unchanged.
